(ba)༄༅/ /gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /rje btsun ma gza' rnams kyi yum bsgom par 'dod pas/stan bde ba la bsdad/bla ma dang dkon mchog gas

tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// rje btsun ma gza' rnams kyi yum bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du yum chen mo bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang 'bral bar gyur cig bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig phan tshun chags pa dang sdang ba med cing mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs par gyur cig snyam du tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 ham̐ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas rdo rje la thim zhing de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma gza'i yum du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas sngo zhing cung zad khro ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas rdo rje/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bkod nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas yum chen mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor bar spyan drang*/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ dri ma thams cad dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de lta bu'i lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de sems mnyam par bzhag sngags zlo bar 'dod na snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis rang gi sdig pa/ sgrib pa/ nad dang bar du gcod pa rnams sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi ye shes dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam pas rang la bstim/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ gdon dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi gdug pa'i sems zhi bar byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bi d+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa t+yai swā hā/ zhes nye snying gang mos la ci nus su bzlas so// bzlas pa tshar ba dang oṃ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyad do// gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas dkar gtor sbyangs pa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas ma dag pa bsang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ rin po che'i snod lha'i bdud rtsi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pas gang bar bskyed/

oṃ a kā ro mu kham̐ sarba dharmā ṇām̐/ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas gtor ma'i mgron rnams kyis bzhed pa'i don thams cad 'byung bar bsam/ de nas rang skad cig gis yum chen mor mos pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas yum chen mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bi d+yā sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba gra ha na k+ṣa tra sarba bhū te bh+yaḥ.i dam̐ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ dngos grub ma lus pa gnang bar bsam/ de nas de dag gi rgyud bskul ba'i phyir/ yum gyi mdo 'don pa la sogs pa bya/ mthar bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol/ cho ga rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o// gza' rnams kyi yum gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa/ las dang po pa rnams kyi don du/ 'phags pas me pho byi ba'i lo khra'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu gsum la thang skyar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
